environment.description: Terraform provider deployed on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, x86_64). The provider binary is compiled with CGO_ENABLED=1 and no stack protector flags. Encryption keys are passed directly as Terraform variables from a CI/CD pipeline (GitLab CI) via TF_VAR_encryption_key environment variable containing raw AES-256 hex key material. The TF_KEY_SLOT_LABEL environment variable is user-controllable via pipeline variables. No memory safety tooling (ASAN/MSAN) is enabled at runtime. The provider process runs as ec2-user with standard memory layout (ASLR enabled but no PIE, no stack canaries due to -fno-stack-protector in CGO_CFLAGS).
